name: Omdura
body:
Alignment: The apprentice’s alignment must be within one step of his mentor’s deity’s, along either the law/chaos axis or the good/evil axis.

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s omdura class levels learns all omdura spells their mentor knows, adding them to their list of spells known for the day. The apprentice casts spells learned from a oracle mentor as divine spells. Spells cast this way use the apprentice’s Charisma regardless of what ability their mentor uses to modify their spells. This ability does not allow an apprentice to cast spell they cannot learn due to their Charisma score or level. Apprentices treat spells learned this way just as any other spontaneous spell caster would their spells known. Your caster level is equal to your apprentice level, and your save DCs and concentration checks are Charisma-based. You’re considered to have the cleric/oracle spell list for purposes of spell completion items and spell trigger items.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s omdura class levels and chooses omdura for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the omdura‘s divine touch class feature. When determining the healing and number of uses per day of the apprentice’s divine touch, the apprentice’s effective omdura level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3. At 10th level and every three levels thereafter, the apprentice can select a divine infusion their mentor possesses to add to their divine touch. Apprentices cannot select a divine infusion that requires 6th level as their first divine infusion. Apprentices cannot select a divine infusion that requires 9th level as their first or second divine infusion. Apprentices cannot select a divine infusion that requires 12th level as their first, second, or third divine infusion.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Charisma

Apprentices who study a mentor’s omdura class levels and chooses omdura for their cooperation power may spend two cooperation points as a standard action to grant benefits to his allies within 30 feet. These benefits are identical to an omdura‘s invocation class feature. When determining the effects of the apprentice’s invocation, the apprentice’s effective omdura level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3. If the apprentice and an ally within 30 feet are using the same invocation, instead, the effects of one invocation are empowered by the other increasing the character’s effective omdura level by 3 for determining the benefits of the invocation. Choosing this cooperation power counts as gaining the invocation class feature for the purposes of the apprentice’s approximate expertise class feature but you must have the cleric cooperation power to benefit from a feat whose prerequisites were met in this manner.
